chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: It is not permissible for the one praying to pray with one prayer unless he has already performed it.
So if he has already performed it, it is permissible for him to pray it again once, either as voluntary (nafl) or for completion (tamam).
ai.seo_question: Can a Muslim repeat their obligatory prayer as voluntary worship?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (AS) clarification on the permissibility of repeating a single obligatory prayer, distinguishing between performing it again as a voluntary supererogatory act (Tatawwu') versus repeating it to rectify a deficiency or fulfill a missed obligation (Qada). This ruling underscores the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the spiritual merit of extra worship while maintaining the integrity of the primary duty. The distinction highlights the scholarly emphasis on intention (Niyyah) in determining the legal status of repeated acts of worship.
